Bidding $15.1 ensures a win against most bids while securing profit ($34 - $15.1 = $18.9) if the second-highest bid is lower. This bid is not dominated, as lower bids risk losing while higher bids reduce profit without increasing win probability significantly.

Bidding my full value or higher is dominated because it risks zero profit. I will bid $20, assuming the others bid closer to their expected values around $10. This maximizes the chance of winning and ensures a positive profit margin if successful.
